payload.title: Preserve the supported AWS credential chain over stale YAML keys
payload.description:
A local worker can have a supported AWS SDK credential source available while legacy static keys remain in Plexus YAML. Configuration loading currently exports the YAML keys unless an explicit profile environment variable is present, which can displace the supported credential provider and cause evidence reads to fail.

Feature: Safe AWS credential-source precedence

Scenario: the default AWS credential chain has a provider
Given the AWS SDK resolves credentials through a supported non-environment provider
And Plexus YAML also contains static access keys
When Plexus loads configuration
Then the static YAML keys are not exported
And the SDK provider remains authoritative

Scenario: no other AWS credential source exists
Given no environment, profile, workload, or SDK credential provider is configured
And Plexus YAML contains static access keys
When Plexus loads configuration
Then the YAML keys remain available as the legacy fallback

Scenario: provider authorization has expired
Given a supported SDK provider is configured but requires reauthentication
When required evidence preflight runs
Then Plexus reports an authorization prerequisite failure
And it does not silently fall back to unrelated static YAML credentials.
